page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with a marginal note at left. Above the text, five lines of Arabic in full width. Below them, the Latin and Arabic paragraphs run down the column. Left margin: "Ib. lib.II." beside the paragraph "A laborum tædiis quiescant". No separate footnotes.

main_text.l: ولیوم الاحد اول ولیوم الاثنین اهون والثلاثا
جبار وللاربعا دبار وللخمیس مونس ولیوم الجمعة
العروبة وكانوا یسمون ایضا یوم السبت البجن
ویوم الاحد هوز ویوم الاثنین حدای والثلاثا
كلمن والاربعا شعفص والخمیس قرشت والجمعة
العروبة Vocabant olim Arabes diem Sabbati Shiyar,
diem Solis Awal, diem Lunæ Ahwan, diem Martis
Jobbar, diem Mercurii Dobbar, diem Iovis Munes, di-
em Veneris Arubah. Appellabant alii diem Sabbati
Abjad, Solis Hawaz, Lunæ Hottai, Martis Colman,
Mercurii Saafas, Iovis Korasht, Veneris Arubah.
Sed posteriora ista à pædagogo aliquo qui literas
puerorum memoriæ infigere voluerit, impofita vi-
dentur.
A laborum tædiis quiescant ] Inter ea quæ ad fitè
observandum diem istum requiruntur, recenset Al-Gazal. ان یجعل
یوم الجمعة للاخرة فی ذیه من ut diem Veneris vita futura ac-
censeant, & in eo ab omni opere mundano abstineant. Qui
autem ad eum observandum teneantur, his docet
verbis فلا تجب الجمعة الا علی كل ذكر بالغ عاقل مسلم حر مقیم في قریة او بلدة تشتمل علی اربعین
جامعین لهذه الصفات او في قریة من سواد البلد یبلغها من طرف یلیها &c. Non tenetur Veneris observare, nisi qui sit Mas ætatis

l.i: matura, intellectu præditus, Moslemus, liber, qui incolat

page.notes: Arabic text in the left and right margins is not present. The Arabic in the paragraph "ان یجعل" and "فلا تجب" is set in a smaller, less clear type; some letters may be misread. The Arabic line "جميع اشغال الدنيا" appears at the end of the line before "ut diem Veneris" and is included in the paragraph flow as printed; its exact placement may differ. The Arabic lines 1–5 are read from the scan with some doubt on individual letters (e.g. "دبار", "حدای", "شعفص"). The run-in "A laborum tædiis quiescant ]" is treated as italic text in the column, not as a margin note. The paragraph ends mid-sentence with "vicum" and continues on the next page.
